title: 第9章 他的母语是无语
slug: 狗哥你再舔女主我就和黄毛私奔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“老大，你来啦！”

李刚顶着一头绿毛，不知道从哪钻出来，向来憨厚的脸上，露出兴奋激动的表情。

不等赵楹月问，便迫不及待道：

“老大，你不知道今天我们网吧的生意有多火爆！”

秦渡是今天早上才来网吧上班的。

那会，店里也就几个包夜的老客。

后来不知怎的，突然就多了一批人过来。

无一例外，全是清一色的女生。

李刚再迟钝，也反应过来这群人来上网是假，看帅哥才是真！

怪不得网上人都说脸可以当饭吃。

原来脸真的可以当饭吃！

秦三这人，他们没白捡！

“不错，让他好好干，”赵楹月满意点头，顿了顿，忽地问，“身份证办下来了吗？”

“范鸽一大早就出去了，估计跑个来回，最迟明天就能到手。”

他们认识办假证的渠道。

平时有家里人和赵楹月盯着，他们自然不敢随便造次。

虽然他们学习不行，但也在争取不做社会的败类。

当初来这海市，还是托了赵楹月的福。

村长怕赵楹月回赵家受欺负，便把他们三一同打包了出去。

幸好，赵家没有什么真假千金套路。

赵楹月一回家就是众星捧月的豪门大小姐。

要风有风，要雨得雨，滋润极了。

后来，见他们在海市找不到工作，赵楹月便想着投资他们做点生意。

李刚三人对他们自己有很清楚的定位。

他们不是做生意的料。

可不能白瞎了老大给的钱。

于是思来想去，决定开一家网吧算了。

抛开店内的成本不算，他们人工这块是不需要额外资金。

三人轮班制，完全周转的开。

这一开，就是大半年的时间。

因为选址的原因，生意一直不温不火。

每个月的收入勉强够他们兄弟三人，在海市生活下去。

不过他们也没什么大志气，很满足现状。

谁知，突然来了大惊喜！

一天的净收入都快赶上他们一个月的了。

这要是天天如此，他们是不是可以在海市买大别墅了？

越想越激动。

看秦渡的眼神里，瞬间多出几分看财神爷的热切。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Boss, you're here!"

Li Gang, with green hair on his head, emerged from nowhere, with an expression of excitement on his usually honest face.

Zhao Yingyue couldn't wait to ask, and said impatiently:

"Boss, you don't know how busy our Internet cafe's business is today!"

Qin Du only came to work at the Internet cafe this morning.

At that time, there were only a few regular customers staying overnight in the store.

Then, for some reason, a group of people suddenly came over.

Without exception, they are all girls.

No matter how slow Li Gang was, he realized that it was fake for these people to go online, and it was real to watch the handsome guys!

No wonder people on the Internet say that your face can be eaten as food.

It turns out that your face can really be eaten!

They didn't pick up Qin San for nothing!

"Yes, let him do a good job," Zhao Yingyue nodded with satisfaction, paused, and suddenly asked, "Have you obtained the ID card?"

"Fan Ge went out early in the morning. I think I can get it by running back and forth at the latest tomorrow."

They know the channels for obtaining fake certificates.

With family members and Zhao Yingyue always watching, they naturally didn't dare to make any mistakes.

Although they are not good at studying, they are still striving not to be the scum of society.

When I first came to Haishi, it was thanks to Zhao Yingyue.

The village chief was afraid that Zhao Yingyue would be bullied when she returned to the Zhao family, so he packed the three of them out.

Fortunately, the Zhao family does not have any real or fake tricks.

As soon as Zhao Yingyue came home, she was the eldest daughter of a wealthy family, surrounded by stars.

It's windy and rainy, and it's extremely moist.

Later, seeing that they could not find jobs in Haishi, Zhao Yingyue thought of investing in them to do some business.

The three of them, Li Gang, have a very clear positioning for themselves.

They are not business material.

But the money given by the boss cannot be wasted.

So after much thought, I decided to open an Internet cafe.

Not counting the costs in the store, they don't need additional funds for labor.

Three-person shift system, full turnaround.

This time, it takes more than half a year.

Because of the location, business has been tepid.

The monthly income is barely enough for the three brothers to live in Haishi.

However, they have no great ambitions and are very satisfied with the status quo.

Who knows, a big surprise suddenly comes!

One day's net income almost catches up with their monthly income.

If this happens every day, can they buy a big villa in Haishi?

The more I think about it, the more excited I become.

The look in Qin Du's eyes instantly showed a little more eagerness for the God of Wealth.
